name: Smoked buffalo
summary: Buffalo loin and shoulder seasoned with lemongrass, ginger, garlic, dried chili, and mắc khén, then hung in the kitchen smoke for months. A good piece stays a little red, and it goes with rượu Mai Hạ.
origin: The 26 Aug 2019 Vĩnh Long feature, citing Báo Cần Thơ. It is a newspaper feature, not the tourism office.
texture: A good piece stays a little red.
seoTitle: Trau gac bep in Mai Chau — buffalo smoked for months
seoDescription: Trâu gác bếp is buffalo loin and shoulder, smoked for months in Thai villages, and eaten with rượu Mai Hạ.
